issues.issue: Independent pronoun entries do not consistently state the stacking order of plural and case (PRON-PL-CASE). Entries 24 (ā), 30 (hù), 112 (tí), 126 (wá), and 129 (í) say they take case and optional plural but omit the explicit order, while their plural counterparts (25, 31, 113, 127, 130) state that case stacks after plural.
issues.correction: In entries 24, 30, 112, 126, and 129, add to the notes: "Case stacks after plural (PRON-PL-CASE)."

issues.issue: Disharmonic stem kʷó.ne ‘tree’: the note says it selects back-harmonic suffixes, but this could be taken as an ad hoc exception unless made explicit as a lexeme-level property.
issues.correction: Revise the notes for kʷó.ne to: "Despite internal disharmony, this lexeme is specified to be back-harmonic for suffix selection (PL -lu; CASE -ko/-no)."

issues.issue: Causative ka-/kʷo- entry says it "requires independent A-pronoun and A-prefix". Since independent A-pronouns are obligatory in all finite clauses anyway, readers may misinterpret this as a special requirement unique to CAUS.
issues.correction: Append to entry 39 notes: "Clarification: independent A-pronouns are obligatory in all finite clauses; CAUS does not change this, it only introduces an additional external causer who is cross-referenced by the A-prefix."

issues.issue: Applicative entries (BEN -pe/-po, LOC -tɬe/-tɬo, COM/INS -re/-ro, GOAL -ke/-ko) say they require a following OBL person index but do not explicitly cross-reference the exact index set in the entry itself.
issues.correction: In entries 12, 13, 17, and 2, add: "The OBL index is selected from the same set as U-index (-nʲi/-nu, -ti/-tu, -ar, -l, -ʃ), with optional plural -li/-lu."

issues.issue: Echo-aspect enclitics vs. aspect suffixes: the two pairs =ke/=ko and =ti/=tu are correctly distinguished functionally, but it is not explicitly stated in the lexicon entries that these enclitics come after the aspect suffix as clausal enclitics (not part of the verbal word).
issues.correction: In entries 19–22, add: "These are clause-final enclitics that follow the aspect suffix; they are prosodic clitics attaching to the clause, not segmental part of the verb word."

issues.issue: Entry 52 (kʷō.mu ‘be black; be dark’) note "Rounding on /k/ phonemic" may be read as conflicting with the general rounding assimilation rule unless clarified that the initial kʷ here is underlying.
issues.correction: Amend the notes in entry 52 to: "Initial kʷ is underlying (phonemic), not just assimilation; rounding assimilation may still apply elsewhere per general rules."

issues.issue: Entry 92 (pɬē.ti.nēlʃ ‘ladle; pouring tool’) is inconsistent with the base verb pɬē.tʲi ‘pour’: the palatalization on t (tʲ) is missing, and the nominalizer is written without a hyphen unlike parallel items (e.g., pjé.le-nēlʃ, tɬé.ke-nēlʃ).
issues.correction: Update the headword to pɬē.tʲi-nēlʃ (with palatalized tʲ) and include the hyphen before -nēlʃ to match the lexicon’s suffixation conventions.

issues.issue: Entry 48 (kʷē.la ‘sit; be seated’) note says “Back harmony with neutral a,” but the stem contains front vowel e and should pattern with front-harmonic suffixes; /a/ is neutral.
issues.correction: Replace the note with: “Front harmony; /a/ is neutral for backness.”

issues.issue: Entry 49 (kʷē.ni ‘know’) note says “Back harmony,” but the stem vowels are front (e, i); suffixal harmony should be front.
issues.correction: Replace the note with: “Front harmony; intervocalic lenition kʷ → ɣʷ applies in V_V contexts.”

issues.issue: The verb tʲê.ɬe ‘hunt’ is used repeatedly in the grammar (e.g., a-tʲê.ɬe-…), but there is no corresponding lexicon entry.
issues.correction: Add a lexicon entry: “tʲê.ɬe, verb, hunt; chase, Transitive; productive with DISTR s-; reciprocal/middle -ri/-ru possible; takes regular agreement; —; Palatalized coronal onset; tone HL on the first syllable as in examples.”

issues.issue: Entry 39 (ka-/kʷo- ‘causative’) note “Fixed order outside DISTR” is unclear about morpheme ordering relative to DISTR.
issues.correction: Revise the note to: “Fixed order CAUS > DISTR > ROOT (CAUS precedes DISTR).”

issues.issue: Entry 61 (kʷó.ne ‘tree’) note “Back harmony” may confuse readers because the stem is internally disharmonic (o + e).
issues.correction: Clarify the note to: “Disharmonic stem (o + e); despite internal disharmony, it selects back-harmonic suffixes.”

issues.issue: GOAL applicative -ke/-ko is described as "immediately after root" (entry 2), which conflicts with the templatic order where RECP/MID (-ri/-ru) comes right after the root and before applicatives.
issues.correction: In entry 2, revise the slot description to: "Occurs after the root and any RECP/MID (-ri/-ru), and before OBL/U/PL; lexically L-toned; distinct from PFV and from preposition kè."

issues.issue: Back-harmonic RECP/MID allomorph -ru is cited with clearly front-harmonic stems, contrary to backness harmony (entries 79 pjé.le, 95 pɬé.re, 114 tɬēk).
issues.correction: Replace "-ru" with the front allomorph "-ri" in entries 79, 95, and 114 (e.g., "intransitive middle with -ri possible"). Optionally clarify as "-ri/-ru (here -ri)" to indicate the general pair and the selected allomorph for these stems.

issues.issue: GOAL applicative behavior (entry 2) omits that, like other applicatives, it requires a following OBL person index.
issues.correction: In entry 2, add: "Requires following OBL person index; licenses a bare NP goal."

issues.issue: Applicative placement relative to RECP/MID is unspecified for BEN -pe/-po, LOC -tɬe/-tɬo, and COM/INS -re/-ro, potentially causing confusion alongside the corrected GOAL description.
issues.correction: In entries 12, 13, and 17, add to the grammar notes: "Occurs after the root and any RECP/MID (-ri/-ru), and before OBL/U/PL."

issues.issue: Entry 49 kʷē.ni is labeled “verb (stative)” but its description says “Transitive cognition verb; can take complement clause headed by nʲē”. issues.correction: Change POS to “verb” (transitive) and remove “(stative)”. In the grammar field, specify: “Transitive cognition verb; A-pattern; can take complement clause headed by nʲē; regular U-indexing on object.” Keep the phonology note about kʷ → ɣʷ under lenition.

issues.issue: Entry 74 pā.ro ‘father’ lists “plural via -li”, but stems with a back non-low vowel (here o) select back-harmonic suffixes, so the plural should be -lu by the language’s harmony rules.
issues.correction: Change “plural via -li” to “plural via -lu” (optionally add a note: “back-harmonic plural”).

issues.correction: Revise the note to “Coda affricate /tɬ/ permitted” (or “Affricate coda tɬ allowed”).
